scope: Spatial precision of autonomous sensor-domain Auto/patch white balance

implementation.model: sample_c = colour_c * (a+b*x+d*y); colour_G=1; common centre; f64
implementation.unchanged_estimator_domain: Complete odd Bayer windows without rejected sites keep historical 20-percent-per-tail trimmed means: channel support is centrally symmetric.
implementation.rejections: Original sensor bounds/coverage plus unsupported or nonpositive model, invalid centre, or nonconvergence; no fallback
implementation.changed_requests: New Auto and eyedropper actions only; saved gains and as-shot rendering unchanged

development.independent_channel_planes: Rejected after a 61440-case development campaign exposed sparse outlier amplification in 5x5 patches.

synthetic_validation.limits: Synthetic sampling/noise study only. Curved and fine-texture scenes deliberately violate the affine model. Not a target measurement, illuminant estimate or camera profile qualification.
synthetic_validation.metric: Relative error of recovered R/B gain, before integer gain quantization
synthetic_validation.noise: Deterministic Gaussian, variance read_variance + 9e-6 * signal; not camera-characterized
synthetic_validation.signal: Common achromatic illumination times sensor neutral [0.5,1,0.75]; fp32 input

direct_executable_attempt.interpretation: Direct executable launch delivered no screenshot events; same bundle passed through LaunchServices as specified for native bundle qualification. Internal cause not established.

limits: The synthetic input is an achromatic spatial signal, not a measured camera target.
Curved shading and fine texture violate the affine assumption and retain nonzero errors; rejected regions are excluded from paired RMS but remain counted.
The model does not identify the true illuminant of a colored scene or qualify grey-world Auto.
No camera profiling or physical color accuracy claim; calibrated captures remain missing.
D850, format expansion, broad fuzzing and Windows remain outside this increment.
